subject: Startups
title: Vanity Metrics
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Vanity Metrics.

hook.text: A startup proudly reports 10 million downloads. But only 50K are active users. The download number is a vanity metric.

buildup.text: Vanity metrics look impressive but don't reflect real business health.

discovery.text: Actionable metrics show what matters: retention, revenue per user, churn rate, and engagement over time.

twist.text: Founders chase vanity metrics because investors and press celebrate big numbers. The incentive structure is broken.

climax.text: Theranos boasted huge partnerships. MoviePass hit 3 million subscribers. Both collapsed behind the flashy numbers.

punchline.text: If a metric can't guide a decision, it's vanity.

quiz.question: What is an example of a vanity metric?
options: Total downloads without active usage data
